title: AMC 8 Guide (short)
style: warm and upbeat, speaking at a brisk, energetic pace, no laughing

lines: AMC eight tip! Think you should leave hard questions blank? Nope!
The AMC eight has twenty-five questions. Each right answer earns one point.
What does a wrong answer cost you? A: one point. B: a quarter point. C: nothing.
A right answer earns one point. A wrong answer earns zero.
And a blank? Also zero. So a guess can only help.
A wild guess has a one in five chance. Cross out two choices, and it's one in three.
The answer is C. A wrong answer costs you nothing!
Leaving it blank was the trap. Answer every question.
Did you pick C? Tell me below!
